'''Brognig''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] that could be served roasted that enjoyed by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]]. [[Matron/Legends|Matron]] [[Kufbrug]] served roast Brognig at a feast at [[Bolgoink Hold]] to celebrate her [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] to [[Guth]].<ref name="MS">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref>
